free_tier.stated: USD 0 free trial: 60 minutes on one small computer (2 vCPU, 4 GB memory, 10 GB disk), no signup and no card.
free_tier.notes: Every new account also gets a free hour of credit with full internet. The anonymous trial's internet is limited to code, package and model sites.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a computer, not a stored object

retention.stated: A stopped computer keeps its files; the trial computer is kept for 3 days after last use and is then deleted. There are no backups.
retention.notes: Signed in within the three days, the computer moves into the account.

egress.terms: Outgoing internet works on paid tiers; the anonymous trial limits it to code and package sites (GitHub, npm, PyPI, Docker Hub) and AI model APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI). Incoming connections are not supported: a port cannot be opened or a website hosted, and listeners are reachable only through the CLI. No per-GB egress price is published.
egress.free_allowance: unmetered outbound traffic on paid tiers; allowlisted destinations on the trial

interface_detail: A CLI starts and drives computers (workpaper run, workpaper exec); TypeScript and Python SDKs and a REST API are documented. A headless browser is installed on the computer.
tooling: curl -fsSL https://workpaper.co/install | sh installs the CLI; workpaper run and workpaper exec start a computer and run commands; TypeScript and Python SDKs are available.
chaining: An agent runs a computer for a task with the CLI, keeps it stopped between tasks and signs into the account to keep files past the trial's three-day window.

limits.value: 60 minutes of runtime on one small computer on the free trial
4 running computers per account on paid tiers; 1 computer and no forks on the trial
trial computer deleted 3 days after last use; idle computers pause after 1 hour

limits_note: Pro bills USD 0.010 per small-VM hour and USD 0.020 per large-VM hour; pay as you go is USD 5 once for 150 small-VM hours. One trial per device every 30 days and one per internet connection per day.
binding_note: The 60-minute runtime on one computer is what runs out first on the free trial; capacity can also stop a trial computer to make room for a paying user.

identity_cost.detail: The free trial installs the CLI and runs a computer with no signup and no card: 'No sign-up, no card'. An account asks for a real email address, and one free trial is allowed per person; paid tiers are paid through Dodo Payments.

reliability_note: No backups: a hardware failure can lose a computer's files. No uptime guarantee, capacity can run out, and a running free computer may be stopped to make room for a paying user.
confidence_note: Rates, trial limits, egress restrictions and the signup gate are quoted from first-party pages read on 2026-11-24.
